profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at MyFitnessPal
profile.summary: Staff Software Engineer with 15+ years of software development experience.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built an AI-powered conversational coach. Helps users understand their data, provide recommendations, fitness guidance and progress tracking.

- Designed and developed heuristic and LLM-driven user insights. Provides real-time feedback on their food logging behavior.

- Connected our data pipelines to Braze. Enables near real-time event processing for marketing campaigns. Handles 10+ Million daily events.

- Designed the roadmap to upgrade all our premium services to notification-driven systems. Allows BI to analyze data in near realtime. Developed all Phase 1:  Migrate to Apple v2 notifications. 

- Consolidated all of our subscription APIs. Saved more than 30 CPUs and more than 192 Gb of RAM. All endpoints are now well documented.

- Leading a team to modernize all our legacy architecture based on Scala 2 and Akka. 

- Designed and implemented a transition plan for the data shared between MyFitnessPal and Under Armour. Deprecated multiple services and saved ~1 Million USD annually in licenses and infrastructure. Snowflake is now the source of truth.

- Perform Security fixes and general Backend support. Deprecated infrastructure saving ~1 Million USD anually.

- Drive cross-team collaboration for new features and initiatives.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Python (Programming Language) · Technical Leadership · Technical Engineering · Data Structures · Unit Testing · Microservices · Automation · Code Review · Redis · Kotlin · Java · Back-End
